title: "Providers"
description: "The services your apps can use, where to get each key, and the command that adds it."
---

A provider is a service your apps use: a model, a search API, people's Google accounts. Your Gateway holds the key, adds it to each call, and never hands it to app code.

Add one with its id. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add openrouter
```

Installing an app? The install asks for every key it needs. Not listed below? [Add any API yourself](/docs/providers/custom).

## AI models

- **[OpenAI](/docs/providers/openai)**: OpenAI's models: responses, chat, embeddings, audio, images.
- **[OpenRouter](/docs/providers/openrouter)**: One key for many models, through OpenAI's API shape.
- **[Workers AI](/docs/providers/workers-ai)**: Cloudflare's models, in the Gateway's own account.
- **[Cloudflare AI Gateway](/docs/providers/ai-gateway)**: Cloudflare's proxy in front of the other AI providers: logs, caching, rate limits and spend, with each provider's own key.
- **[Anthropic](/docs/providers/anthropic)**: Claude models through the Messages API.
- **[Google Gemini](/docs/providers/gemini)**: Google's Gemini models through their OpenAI-compatible endpoint: chat, embeddings, images.
- **[Mistral AI](/docs/providers/mistral)**: Mistral's models: chat, code completion, embeddings, moderation, OCR, speech.
- **[Groq](/docs/providers/groq)**: Open models on Groq through OpenAI's API shape: chat, responses, transcription, speech.
- **[Cohere](/docs/providers/cohere)**: Cohere's models: chat, embeddings, reranking, classification, transcription, document parsing.

## Speech, images and embeddings

- **[Voyage AI](/docs/providers/voyage)**: Embeddings and rerankers for search and retrieval: text, code, multimodal, contextualized chunks.
- **[Replicate](/docs/providers/replicate)**: Runs open-source and official models by API: images, video, audio and language.
- **[Hugging Face Inference](/docs/providers/huggingface)**: Open models from Hugging Face's inference providers through one router: chat, embeddings, images, speech.
- **[Deepgram](/docs/providers/deepgram)**: Speech to text, text to speech and text analysis.
- **[ElevenLabs](/docs/providers/elevenlabs)**: Text to speech, speech to text, sound effects, music and voice changing.
- **[AssemblyAI](/docs/providers/assemblyai)**: Transcribes recorded audio and video, with speaker labels, redaction and subtitles.

## Search, scraping and data

- **[DataForSEO](/docs/providers/dataforseo)**: SEO data: keyword metrics, live search results, domain rankings, backlinks.
- **[Context.dev](/docs/providers/context)**: Scrapes and renders web pages, JavaScript included.
- **[Mapbox](/docs/providers/mapbox)**: Maps and location: geocoding, directions, styles, tilesets and datasets.
- **[OpenWeather](/docs/providers/openweather)**: Weather data: current conditions, forecasts, One Call, history and weather map tiles.
- **[Perplexity](/docs/providers/perplexity)**: Web-grounded answers from the Agent API, raw web search results, and embeddings.
- **[Jina AI](/docs/providers/jina)**: Reads web pages as Markdown, searches the web, and embeds and reranks text and images.
- **[Firecrawl](/docs/providers/firecrawl)**: Scrapes, crawls, maps and searches the web, returning clean markdown or structured data.
- **[Exa](/docs/providers/exa)**: Web search built for AI: search results, page contents, similar links and cited answers.
- **[Tavily](/docs/providers/tavily)**: Web search, page extraction, crawling and site maps for AI agents, plus research reports.
- **[Serper](/docs/providers/serper)**: Google search results as JSON: web, news, images, places, shopping, scholar and patents.
- **[Brave Search](/docs/providers/brave-search)**: Brave's independent web index: web, news, images, videos, places, LLM context and answers.
- **[Apify](/docs/providers/apify)**: Runs Apify Actors (ready-made scrapers and automations) and reads their datasets and stores.
- **[NewsAPI](/docs/providers/newsapi)**: Searches news articles and live headlines from over 150,000 sources.

## Email and messaging

- **[Email sending](/docs/providers/email)**: Mail from the Gateway and every app, through Cloudflare Email Sending or Resend.
- **[Slack](/docs/providers/slack)**: People connect their own Slack accounts.
- **[Postmark](/docs/providers/postmark)**: Transactional email: single, batch and templated messages from one Postmark server.
- **[SendGrid](/docs/providers/sendgrid)**: Twilio SendGrid email: send transactional and marketing mail through the v3 Mail Send API.
- **[Twilio](/docs/providers/twilio)**: SMS, MMS and voice: send text messages and place calls from your Twilio numbers.
- **[Intercom](/docs/providers/intercom)**: Customer messaging: contacts, companies, conversations, tickets and help center articles.
- **[Crisp](/docs/providers/crisp)**: Customer chat: conversations, messages, people and visitors of one Crisp workspace.

## Payments and commerce

- **[Stripe](/docs/providers/stripe)**: Payments: customers, subscriptions, invoices, charges and payouts.
- **[Lemon Squeezy](/docs/providers/lemonsqueezy)**: Merchant of record for software: stores, products, orders, subscriptions, license keys.
- **[Paddle](/docs/providers/paddle)**: Paddle Billing: products, prices, customers, subscriptions and transactions.
- **[Shopify](/docs/providers/shopify)**: One store's Admin API (GraphQL): products, orders, customers and inventory.
- **[Plaid](/docs/providers/plaid)**: Bank data: accounts, balances, transactions and identity, for the Items an app links.

## CRM, docs and work tools

- **[Google](/docs/providers/google)**: People connect their own accounts: Gmail, Calendar, Search Console and Analytics.
- **[Microsoft](/docs/providers/microsoft)**: People connect their own accounts: Outlook mail and calendar.
- **[Attio](/docs/providers/attio)**: CRM: people, companies, deals, lists, notes and tasks in one Attio workspace.
- **[HubSpot](/docs/providers/hubspot)**: CRM and marketing: contacts, companies, deals, tickets and more in one HubSpot account.
- **[Pipedrive](/docs/providers/pipedrive)**: Sales CRM: deals, persons, organizations, activities and pipelines.
- **[Airtable](/docs/providers/airtable)**: Bases, tables and records in the Airtable workspaces a token can reach.
- **[Notion](/docs/providers/notion)**: Pages, databases and blocks that a Notion connection has been given.
- **[Granola](/docs/providers/granola)**: Meeting notes: list, search and read notes with their AI summaries, transcripts, folders and spaces.
- **[Linear](/docs/providers/linear)**: Issue tracking over GraphQL: issues, projects, cycles, comments and teams.
- **[Atlassian (Jira and Confluence)](/docs/providers/atlassian)**: Jira issues and Confluence pages on the sites the person grants.
- **[Zoom](/docs/providers/zoom)**: The person's meetings and recordings.
- **[Dropbox](/docs/providers/dropbox)**: Files and folders in the person's Dropbox.

## Developer tools and infrastructure

- **[GitHub](/docs/providers/github)**: Code hosting: repositories, issues, pull requests, Actions and releases through the REST API.
- **[GitLab](/docs/providers/gitlab)**: Code hosting on GitLab.com: projects, issues, merge requests, pipelines and releases.
- **[Vercel](/docs/providers/vercel)**: Frontend hosting: projects, deployments, domains and logs through the Vercel REST API.
- **[Cloudflare](/docs/providers/cloudflare)**: Cloudflare's API: zones, DNS, Workers, R2, D1, KV and the rest of an account.
- **[PostHog](/docs/providers/posthog)**: Product analytics: insights, feature flags, persons, cohorts, experiments and HogQL queries.
- **[Mixpanel](/docs/providers/mixpanel)**: Product analytics: saved reports, profiles, raw event export and event import.
- **[Segment](/docs/providers/segment)**: Sends identify, track, page, group and alias events to a Segment source.
- **[Supabase](/docs/providers/supabase)**: A Supabase project's Postgres REST API and Storage, with its secret key.
- **[Turso](/docs/providers/turso)**: Turso's Platform API: databases, groups, locations and usage for one organization.
- **[Neon](/docs/providers/neon)**: Neon's management API: Postgres projects, branches, databases, roles and endpoints.
- **[Pinecone](/docs/providers/pinecone)**: Vector database: indexes, namespaces, vectors and documents, plus hosted embedding and rerank.

## Social and content

- **[Spotify](/docs/providers/spotify)**: The person's library, playlists and listening.
- **[X (OAuth 2)](/docs/providers/x)**: Posts and the person's profile on X, over the v2 API.
- **[LinkedIn](/docs/providers/linkedin)**: Posts on a member's profile and on the company pages they admin.
- **[Facebook Pages](/docs/providers/facebook)**: Facebook pages, and the Instagram business accounts linked to them.
- **[Instagram](/docs/providers/instagram)**: An Instagram professional account on its own, without a Facebook page.
- **[Threads](/docs/providers/threads)**: Posts, replies and insights on a Threads profile.
- **[YouTube](/docs/providers/youtube)**: YouTube channels and their analytics, and Google Business Profiles.
- **[Reddit](/docs/providers/reddit)**: Reading subreddits and posting as the person.
- **[Pinterest](/docs/providers/pinterest)**: Boards and pins on a Pinterest account.
- **[Discord](/docs/providers/discord)**: The person's Discord account and servers, and installing a bot in a server.
- **[Kick](/docs/providers/kick)**: A Kick channel and its chat.
- **[Twitch](/docs/providers/twitch)**: A Twitch channel's chat and announcements.
- **[Tumblr](/docs/providers/tumblr)**: Posting to the person's Tumblr blogs.

## Sign-in only

- **[Apple](/docs/providers/apple)**: "Continue with Apple" on your Gateway's sign-in page.
- **[Single sign-on (OIDC)](/docs/providers/oidc)**: "Continue with SSO" on your Gateway's sign-in page.
